structure_explanation.en: 私の誕生日 ('my birthday') is the topic, with の indicating possession and は marking the theme. The copula です closes the sentence politely, in the pattern A は B です ('A is B').

A cópula です fecha a frase de forma polida, no padrão A は B です ('A é B').

structure_explanation.en: The structure is [place]に [thing]が あります, the existence pattern with ある for inanimate things. 左側に ('on the left side') indicates the place with に, 郵便局 ('post office') is the subject marked by が, and あります ('there is,' polite) affirms the existence. Here が (and not は) presents the post office as new information.

Aqui が (e não は) apresenta o correio como informação nova.
